metadata.source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), text ID 238. http://www.sanskrit-linguistics.org/dcs/ Segmentation follows the DCS line/pāda boundaries; chapter and verse labels are taken from the DCS references.

children.text: Chapter 1
samaikṣiṣyordhvamahasa ādityena sahīyasā
children.translated_text: I have looked upward with the greatness of the stronger <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ yaśasvināṃ yaśo viśvā rūpāṇy ā dade ||
children.translated_text: I take to myself the glory of the glorious ones and all their forms.

children.text: udyann adya vi no bhaja pitā putrebhyo yathā
children.translated_text: Rising today, apportion blessing to us, as a father does to his sons.

children.text: dīrghāyutvasya heśiṣe tasya no dhehi sūrya ||
children.translated_text: You are lord over long life; place that for us, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: udyantaṃ tvā mitramaha ārohantaṃ vicakṣaṇa
children.translated_text: O you of the greatness of <s>Mitra</s>, as you rise and ascend, all-seeing,

children.text: paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam ||
children.translated_text: may we see a hundred autumns; may we live a hundred autumns.

children.text: abhi tyaṃ meṣaṃ puruhūtam ṛgmiyam ||
children.translated_text: I call upon that ram, the much-invoked one, worthy of hymns.

children.text: Chapter 2
śaśvan nāsatyā yuvayor mahitvaṃ gāvo arcanti sadam it purukṣū
children.translated_text: Always, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, the cows praise your greatness, ever rich in abundance.

children.text: yad ūhathur aśvinā bhujyum astam anārambhaṇe adhvani taugryam astam ||
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you carried <s>Bhujyu</s>, the son of <s>Tugra</s>, home over a path without support, homeward.

children.text: yad aśvaṃ śvetaṃ dadhatur abhighnan nāsatyā bhujyū sumatāya pedave
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you gave the white horse, striking down foes, to <s>Pedu</s> for favor toward <s>Bhujyu</s>,

children.text: taṃ vāṃ ratiṃ vidatheṣu viprā rebhanto dasrāv agaman manasyum ||
children.translated_text: that gift of yours the inspired poets, resounding in the assemblies, have approached in their mind, O wondrous ones.

children.text: ā no vipanyū savanaṃ juṣethām ā vāṃ haṃsāḥ suyujo vahantu
children.translated_text: Come to our pressing and gladly accept it; let well-yoked swans bring you here.

children.text: yuvāṃ stomāso janayo na maryā uśanto dasrā vṛṣaṇā sacante ||
children.translated_text: The hymns, like eager women toward men, attend you two, O wondrous, virile ones.

children.text: ā no yātaṃ trivṛtā somapeyaṃ rathena dyukṣāsavanaṃ madāya
children.translated_text: Come to us for soma-drinking with your threefold chariot, bright in the pressing, for exhilaration.

children.text: stīrṇaṃ vāṃ barhiḥ suṣutā madhūni yuktā hotāro rathināḥ suhastāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sacred grass has been spread for you, the sweet draughts are well pressed; the skillful hotars are yoked, chariot-borne, with good hands.

children.text: vāsātyau citrau jagato nidhānau dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me
children.translated_text: O wondrous pair, variegated foundations of the world, O heaven and earth, O two worlds, hear me.

children.text: tāv aśvinā rāsabhāśvā havam me śubhaspatī āgataṃ sūryayā saha ||
children.translated_text: Come to my call, O <s>Aśvins</s> with ass-drawn steeds, lords of beauty, together with <s>Sūryā</s>.

children.text: perṣaḥ santu madhuno ghṛtasya tīvraṃ somaṃ ni vapantu śuṣmiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Let there be portions of honey and ghee; let the vigorous ones pour down the sharp soma.

children.text: evaṃ tathā yuvaty aśvinau bāhū ūrjaṃ duhatu madhunā ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: Thus, in that way, let the two <s>Aśvins</s> milk strength with their youthful arms, with honey and ghee.

children.text: agne mandantu yatayaḥ stomaḥ pra ṇu tyaṃ divaṃ yānti gharmam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, let the ascetics delight; the hymn now goes forth to that sky, to the heated oblation.

children.text: caturdaśaṃ tridivaṃ yuvānam ojo mimāte draviṇaṃ sumeke ||
children.translated_text: They measure out the fourteenth, the third heaven, the young one, strength and wealth for the well-fashioned ones.

children.text: hariṃ hinomi dayamāno aṃśuṃ purumīḍham ṛṣabhaṃ jayan
children.translated_text: I impel the tawny drop, showing mercy, the much-praised bull, conquering.

children.text: haryaśvaṃ haritaḥ saptāśvaṃ yuktanemiṃ trinābhiṃ varuṇaṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: The bay-horsed one, tawny, seven-horsed, with yoked rim and three naves, <s>Varuṇa</s>, for well-being.

children.text: somo vaiṣṇavaṃ mahimānam ojaḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ suvīrā narāḥ prīṇayanti
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, the Vaiṣṇava greatness and strength, is gladdened by the seven seers, heroic men.

children.text: saudhanvanāsaḥ suhastāḥ śamībhis tvaṣṭam aṅgirasam ṛbhavaṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: The descendants of <s>Sudhanvan</s>, good-handed with their implements, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Aṅgiras</s>, and the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, for well-being.

children.text: iheha vo maghavan ni dadhāmi dhruvaṃ tīvraṃ ca taṃ hṛdiyantaṃ bṛhaspatim
children.translated_text: Here and here, O bountiful one, I set down the firm, sharp one, and that <s>Bṛhaspati</s> that goes to the heart.

children.text: sate dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate gharmaś cit taptaḥ pravṛje vahanti ||
children.translated_text: For you I set wealth for the offerer; even the heated gharma-oblation they carry in the enclosure.

children.text: śaśvat sauparṇau viṣitastukaṃ vāyasaṃ viśvabhujaḥ pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau
children.translated_text: The two eternal fair-winged ones, the loosened-tufted crow, the all-enjoying path-guardians, seeing men,

children.text: iyaṃ hitvā dayamānaṃ pṛñcadbhir māṃ vāyaso doṣād dayamāno abūbudhat ||
children.translated_text: this crow, leaving the compassionate one, with those who mix, awakened me from harm, showing mercy.

children.text: tam ekanemiṃ trivṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ śatāvāraṃ viṃśatipratyarābhiḥ
children.translated_text: That wheel of one rim, threefold, with sixteen spokes, with a hundred enclosures and twenty counter-spokes,

children.text: aṣṭakaiḥ ṣaḍbhir viśvarūpaikapāśaṃ trimārgabhedaṃ dvinimittaikamoham ||
children.translated_text: with eight and six, of every form, with one noose, split into three paths, with two causes and one delusion.

children.text: sadaṃ ekamekaṃ tasthuṣaḥ pañcatriṃśād daśaparam
children.translated_text: One after another, the settled thing stood, thirty-five with ten beyond.

children.text: triṃśataṃ śivaṃ navaguhyaṃ yajñam aṣṭaṣaṣṭhaṃ vidat ||
children.translated_text: He knew the auspicious thirty, the nine-secret sacrifice, the sixty-eighth.

children.text: atiṣṭhad vajraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ suvīraṃ dadhanvān devaṃ harim indrakeśam
children.translated_text: He stood, holding the virile thunderbolt, heroic, the divine tawny one with <s>Indra</s>'s hair.

children.text: āyāṃ indraḥ ṣoḍaśī śarma yacchatu ṣaḍvarmiṇam ekaṃ dhruvaṃ te sākam ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, the sixteenth, grant shelter here, together with your one firm six-armored protection.

children.text: Chapter 3
pra dhārā yantu madhuno ghṛtasya yad avindataṃ sūrī usriyāyām
children.translated_text: Let streams of honey and ghee flow forth, which the patrons found among the ruddy cows.

children.text: mitrāvaruṇau bhuvanasya kārū tā me aśvinā juṣatāṃ savanā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the makers of the world, and the two <s>Aśvins</s>, let them accept my pressings.

children.text: sukhaṃ rathaṃ śatayāvānam āśuṃ prātaryāvāṇaṃ suṣadaṃ hiraṇyayam
children.translated_text: The pleasant chariot, going a hundred ways, swift, going in the morning, easy to sit in, golden,

children.text: ā tiṣṭhad yatra duhitā vivasvatas tam evārvāñcam avase karāmahe ||
children.translated_text: where the daughter of <s>Vivasvat</s> mounted it: that very chariot, turned hither, we make for aid.

children.text: ye vām aśvāso rathirā vipaścito vātadhrājiṣaḥ suyujo ghṛtaścutaḥ
children.translated_text: Those horses of yours, chariot-bearing and wise, rushing like the wind, well-yoked, dripping ghee,

children.text: yebhir yātha upa sūryāṃ vareyaṃ tebhir no dasrā vardhataṃ samatsu ||
children.translated_text: with which you go to the chosen <s>Sūryā</s>, with those, O wondrous ones, strengthen us in battles.

children.text: yad vāṃ reto aśvinā poṣayitnu yad rāsabho vadhrimatyaiḥ sudānū
children.translated_text: That generative seed of yours, O <s>Aśvins</s>, that nourishes, which the generous ass gave to <s>Vadhrimatī</s>,

children.text: yasmājjajñe devakāmaḥ sudakṣas tad asyai dattaṃ bhiṣajāv abhidyū ||
children.translated_text: from which the god-loving, skillful one was born: give that to this woman, O physicians, in the bright day.

children.text: yan nāsatyā bheṣajaṃ citrabhānu yenāvathus tokakāmām u nu ghoṣām
children.translated_text: That remedy of yours, O <s>Nāsatyas</s> of bright splendor, with which you helped <s>Ghoṣā</s>, who desired offspring,

children.text: tad asyai dattaṃ triṣu puṃsu vadhvai yenāvindatu nayaṃ sā suhastyam ||
children.translated_text: give that to this bride among three males, by which she may find guidance and capable skill.

children.text: vaṣaḍ vāṃ dasrāv asmin sute nāsatyā hotā kṛṇotu vedhāḥ
children.translated_text: At this pressed soma, O wondrous <s>Nāsatyas</s>, let the inspired hotar make the vaṣaṭ-call for you.

children.text: sisratāṃ nāry ṛtaprajātā vi parvāṇi jihatāṃ sūtavā u ||
children.translated_text: Let the woman born in accordance with truth flow forth; let her who bears offspring loosen her joints.

children.text: evā niṣac copaniṣac ca viprā yuvāṃ rebhatyau sayujā suparṇyau
children.translated_text: Thus, sitting down and sitting near, the inspired ones praise you two, joined, well-winged, resounding.

children.text: brāhmaṇyakratū vidatheṣu śakrā dhattaṃ tayos tanayaṃ tokam agryam ||
children.translated_text: O powerful ones whose will is brahman, in the assemblies place in them excellent progeny and offspring.

children.text: Chapter 4
jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadaṃ bhūrimāyam
children.translated_text: The luminous, sign-bearing, three-wheeled, pleasant chariot, easy to sit in and rich in marvels,

children.text: citrāmaghā yasya yoge idhi jajñe taṃ vāṃ huve atiriktaṃ pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: at whose yoking brilliant bounty was born: I call that excess portion of yours to drink.

children.text: yuvaṃ devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktā rathena taviṣaṃ yajatrā
children.translated_text: You two gods, worthy of sacrifice, yoked by ancient insight with your powerful chariot,

children.text: ā gacchataṃ nāsatyā śacībhir idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ pibāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: come here, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, with your powers; drink this third pressing.

children.text: yuvāṃ devās traya ekādaśāsaḥ satyā satyasya dadhire purastāt
children.translated_text: The thirty-three gods placed you two, true ones, before the truth.

children.text: asmākaṃ yajñaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇā pātaṃ somam aśvinā dīdyagnī ||
children.translated_text: Accepting our sacrifice and pressing, drink the soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>, O blazing fires.

children.text: panāyyaṃ tad aśvinākṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: That praiseworthy deed was done by you <s>Aśvins</s>; the bull of heaven, of midspace, and of earth is yours.

children.text: sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭhau sarvān it tāṁ upa yātaṃ pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: Come to all those thousand praises, and to those in the search for cattle, in order to drink.

children.text: ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihito yajatremā giro nāsatyopa yātam
children.translated_text: This share of yours has been set aside, O worthy ones of sacrifice; come to these songs, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantam aśvinā pra dāśvāṃsam avataṃ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink the honey-sweet soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>; with your powers protect the giver of offerings.

children.text: jyotiṣmantaṃ supratīkam ajasreṇa bhānunā dīdyagnī
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, shining with light, fair-faced, gleaming with unfailing radiance,

children.text: śivaṃ prajānāṃ kṛṇuṣva mā hiṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat ||
children.translated_text: make the creatures auspicious; do not harm man or the moving world.

children.text: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ tvaṣṭā yad dūto abhavad vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s>, bounty, and <s>Savitṛ</s> accept this, when <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> became the messenger of <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: saṃ vām aśvibhyām uṣasā sajūs tam ūrvaṃ gavyaṃ mahi gṛṇāna indra ||
children.translated_text: Together with the <s>Aśvins</s> and with <s>Uṣas</s>, allied, O widely praised <s>Indra</s>, bestow great wealth in cattle.

children.text: bharadvājasya sunvato yaviṣṭhā yāhy agne madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: O youngest <s>Agni</s>, come to <s>Bharadvāja</s> as he presses soma; the most honey-sweet draught has been pressed.

children.text: somasya mā tavaso dīdhyāno acchā kośaṃ janayitvāvato bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: May you, blazing toward the soma of the mighty one, become one who brings help to the vessel after producing it.

children.text: agniḥ pṛthur brahmaṇaspatiḥ somo deveṣv ā yamat
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, broad and vast, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, and <s>Soma</s> has extended among the gods,

children.text: indrasyādhipatyam me bṛhaspate havīṃṣi te ||
children.translated_text: the overlordship of <s>Indra</s>; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, my oblations are for you.

children.text: rucaṃ brāhmyaṃ janayanto devā agre yad abruvan
children.translated_text: When in the beginning the gods, generating brahmanic radiance, spoke,

children.text: yas tvedam brāhmaṇo vidyāt tasya devā asan vaśe ||
children.translated_text: the gods came under the control of the brāhmaṇa who should know this of you.

children.text: Chapter 5
kṛśas tvaṃ bhuvanapate pāti devānām adbhutaḥ
children.translated_text: You are lean, O lord of beings, wondrous guardian of the gods.

children.text: aśvinā pātam asmayū nāsatyā tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, protect us, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, through the day.

children.text: tvaṃ taṃ suparṇa ā bhara divas putrā niṣedire
children.translated_text: You, O fair-winged one, bring him here; the sons of heaven have taken their seats.

children.text: agniḥ prajānām abhavaj jātavedo vicarṣaṇe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Jātavedas</s> became lord of creatures among the peoples.

children.text: agnir hotā vibhūr vasur devānām uttamaṃ yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the hotṛ priest, all-pervading wealth, the highest glory of the gods.

children.text: punar agniḥ prajāpatir vaiśvānaro hiraṇyayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Again <s>Agni</s> is <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, golden in form.

children.text: agnis trātā śivo bhavad varūthyo viśvadevyoḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> become a protector, auspicious, sheltering, belonging to all the gods.

children.text: draviṇaṃ pāhi viśvataḥ somapā abhayaṅkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guard wealth on every side, soma-drinking one, maker of fearlessness.

children.text: agne ni jahi varmāṇy arātīṇāṃ ca marmaṇām
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, strike down the armors and the vulnerable points of enemies.

children.text: dīrghāyutvasya heśiṣe tasya no dhehi sūrya ||
children.translated_text: You rule over long life; grant that to us, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: udyantaṃ tvā mitramaha ārohantaṃ vicakṣaṇa
children.translated_text: O great <s>Mitra</s>, clear-seeing one, may we behold you as you rise and ascend,

children.text: paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam ||
children.translated_text: may we see a hundred autumns; may we live a hundred autumns.

children.text: kṛśaṃ cyavānam ṛṣim andham aśvinā jujurvāṃsaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ karvarebhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your remedies you made the lean, fallen, aged, blind seer <s>Cyavana</s>

children.text: akṣaṇvantaṃ sthūlavapuṣkam ugrā punar yuvānaṃ patim it kanīnām ||
children.translated_text: possessed of eyes, stout-bodied, formidable, young again, indeed the husband of maidens.

children.text: yo vāṃ somair haviṣā yo ghṛtena vedena yo manasā vāśa śakrā
children.translated_text: Whoever has called upon you, O mighty ones, with somas, with oblation, with ghee, with sacred knowledge, or with mind,

children.text: sa dhatte ratnaṃ dyumad indravantam puruspṛhaṃ pṛtanājyaṃ suvīram ||
children.translated_text: he obtains bright treasure, accompanied by <s>Indra</s>, much desired, battle-winning, and rich in heroes.

children.text: pra vāṃ narā saptavadhrir manīṣā giraṃ hinvat prativābhyām idānīm
children.translated_text: Now <s>Saptavadhri</s> urges forth to you, O men, with thought, a song with answering prayers.

children.text: vṛkṣe sambaddham uśanā yuvānam atha taṃ kṛṇutam mā virapśinam ||
children.translated_text: Young <s>Uśanas</s>, bound in a tree: then make him not injured, not maimed.

children.text: ajohavīt saptavadhriḥ suhasto druṇi baddho 'ryasamānaḥ kakudmān
children.translated_text: <s>Saptavadhri</s> of good hands called out, bound in the wooden vessel, noble-like, with a hump.

children.text: arūrujataṃ yuvam asya vṛkṣam adriṃ na vajrī suvṛṣāyamāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two broke open his tree, as the wielder of the thunderbolt, strongly bull-like, breaks a rock.

children.text: evā kṛśaś cakamānam anā...ḥ suhavā rātisūrāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Kṛśa</s>, desirous, ...; the easily invoked givers of bounty are generous.

children.text: brahmacakre yuvayor vardhanāni dhattaṃ tasmai sadam arātidabdhim ||
children.translated_text: He made sacred formulations for the increase of you two; grant to him constant protection, unassailed by hostility.

children.text: Chapter 6
imāni vāṃ bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām
children.translated_text: These allotted shares flow forth for you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for your greatness in the pressed soma rites.

children.text: yajñe yajñe hi savanā bhuraṇyatho yat sunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For at every sacrifice you hasten to the libations, since you instruct the soma-pressing sacrificer.

children.text: niṣṣidhvarīr oṣadhīr āpa ābhyām indrāvaruṇā mahimānam āśata
children.translated_text: The herbs and waters, irresistible, attained greatness through these two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yā tasthatū rajasas pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrur nakir ādeva ohate ||
children.translated_text: They stood beyond the path of the midspace; no enemy at all attacks those two as a god.

children.text: satyaṃ tad indrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutam madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇīḥ
children.translated_text: True is that, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>: the seven voices, rich in ghee, milk a wave of honey.

children.text: tābhir dāśvāṃsam avataṃ śubhaspatī yo vām adabdho abhipāti cittibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With them, O lords of beauty, protect the giver, who, unbetrayed, watches over you with thoughts.

children.text: ghṛtapruṣaḥ saumyā jīradānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadana ṛtasya
children.translated_text: The ghee-sprinkling, soma-like, swiftly giving seven sisters are in the seat of truth.

children.text: yā ha vām indrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutā tābhir dakṣaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam ||
children.translated_text: Those ghee-streaming ones of yours, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>: with them grant skill to the sacrificer.

children.text: avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyām mahimānam indriyam
children.translated_text: We have spoken for great good fortune, declaring the true, blazing, powerful greatness of the two.

children.text: asmān sv indrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutā tribhiḥ saptebhir avataṃ śubhaspatī ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, rich in ghee, O lords of beauty, protect us with the three sevens.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā yad ṛṣibhyo manīṣā vāco matiṃ śrutam ādhattam agre
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, when in the beginning you placed inspired thought, speech, understanding, and hearing among the seers,

children.text: tāni chandāṃsy asṛjanta dhīrā yajñaṃ tanvānās tapasābhyapaśyan ||
children.translated_text: then the wise created those metres; extending the sacrifice, they beheld it through tapas.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā saumanasam adṛptaṃ rāyas poṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhattam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, place unarrogant goodwill and the increase of wealth among the sacrificers.

children.text: prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ rayim asmāsu dhattaṃ dīrghāyutvāya pra tirataṃ na āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place offspring, nourishment, and riches among us; extend our lifespan for long life.

children.text: Chapter 7
ayaṃ somaḥ suśamī adribudhnaḥ pariṣkṛto matibhir ukthaśastaḥ
children.translated_text: This soma, well-prepared, resting on the pressing stones, purified, praised with thoughts and hymns,

children.text: gobhiḥ śrīto matsaraḥ sāmagīto makṣū parvate pari vāṃ suśiprā ||
children.translated_text: mixed with milk, exhilarating, sung by sāman-chant, quickly comes around the mountain to you, O fair-lipped ones.

children.text: asya pājasaḥ pibataṃ sutasya vāreṣṭhāvyāḥ paripūtasya vṛṣṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Drink of this forceful, pressed, bull-like soma, purified through the best strainer of wool.

children.text: tāv aśvinā jaṭharam āpṛṇethām athā mano vasudheyāya dhattam ||
children.translated_text: May you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, fill your bellies; then set your minds toward the granting of wealth.

children.text: eha yātaṃ tanvā śāśadānā madhūni naś cakamānā nu medhām
children.translated_text: Come here with bodies growing strong, desiring our honeyed drinks and our insight.

children.text: vi svā mandrā pururejamānā yuvāyatī havate vām manīṣā ||
children.translated_text: The pleasant, widely-stirring, ever-young inspired thought calls to you both on every side.

children.text: sukhan nāsatyā ratham aṁśumantaṃ syonaṃ suvahnim adhi tiṣṭhataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, mount the comfortable, radiant, pleasant, well-drawing chariot, you two,

children.text: yaṃ vāṃ vahanti harito vahiṣṭhā śatam aśvā yadi vā sapta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: which the best-bearing tawny steeds carry for you, whether a hundred horses or seven divine ones.

children.text: yaṃ venan tāgacchatam mānavasya śāryātasya śadanaṃ śasyamānā
children.translated_text: Come to the praised dwelling of the human <s>Śāryāta</s>, to which you two went in search,

children.text: abībhayuḥ sadhamādaṃ cakānaś cyavano devān yuvayoḥ sa eṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Cyavana</s>, desiring the common feast, was not afraid of the gods; this is he who belongs to you two.

children.text: ā no aśvinā trivṛtā rathenārvāṃcaṃ rayiṃ vahataṃ suvīram
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, bring to us, hither, wealth rich in heroes with your threefold chariot.

children.text: śṛṇvantā vām avase johavīmi vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||
children.translated_text: Hear me as I call upon you for help; be for our growth in the winning of prize and strength.

children.text: Chapter 8
ā yasmin devavītaye putrāso yanto saṃyyataḥ
children.translated_text: To that rite for the gods in which the sons go forth together, well-controlled...

children.text: anādhṛṣṭaṃ vipanyayā prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣat
children.translated_text: Unassailable by hostile traffic, boldly toward your renowned one.

children.text: ahaṃ rudrebhir vasubhiś carāmi ||
children.translated_text: I move together with the <s>Rudras</s> and the <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: Chapter 9
ā rātri pārthivaṁ rajaḥ pitur aprāyi dhāmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: O Night, the earthly realm has been filled by the abodes of the father.

children.text: divas sadāṁsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Broad one, you stand apart in the seats of heaven, and fierce darkness turns toward us.

children.text: ye te rātri nṛcakṣaso yuktāso navatir nava
children.translated_text: Those watchers of men that are yours, O Night, yoked in ninety-nine numbers,

children.text: aśītis santv aṣṭā uto sapta saptatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: let there be eighty-eight of them, and also seventy-seven.

children.text: rātriṃ pra padye jananīṃ sarvabhūtaniveśanīm
children.translated_text: I take refuge in Night, the mother, the resting-place of all beings,

children.text: bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato niśām ||
children.translated_text: auspicious, blessed, dark, the night of the whole moving world.

children.text: saṃveśanīṃ saṃyamanīṃ grahanakṣatramālinīm
children.translated_text: She who causes repose, who restrains, who is garlanded with planets and constellations,

children.text: prapanno 'haṃ śivāṃ rātrīṃ bhadre pāram aśīmahi
children.translated_text: I, having taken refuge in auspicious Night, may we cross to the farther shore, O gracious one.

children.text: mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu ||
children.translated_text: May brilliance be mine, O <s>Agni</s>, in the invocations.

children.text: stoṣyāmi prayato devīṃ śaraṇyām bahvṛcapriyām
children.translated_text: Purified, I shall praise the goddess who gives refuge and is dear to the Bahvṛcas,

children.text: sahasrasaṃmitāṃ durgāṃ jātavedase sunavāma somam ||
children.translated_text: the thousandfold <s>Durgā</s>: for <s>Jātavedas</s> we shall press soma.

children.text: śāntyarthaṃ taddvijātīnām ṛṣibhiḥ samupāśritāḥ
children.translated_text: For the sake of peace for those twice-born men, she has been resorted to by the seers.

children.text: ṛgvede tvaṃ samutpannārātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You arose in the <s>Ṛgveda</s>; the Veda burns down the hostile attacker.

children.text: ye tvāṃ devi prapadyanti brāhmaṇā havyavāhanīm
children.translated_text: Those Brahmins who take refuge in you, O goddess, as the carrier of oblations,

children.text: avidyā bahuvidyā vā sa naḥ parṣad ati durgāṇi viśvā ||
children.translated_text: whether with ignorance or much knowledge, may she carry us across all difficulties.

children.text: ye agnivarṇāṃ śubhāṃ saumyāṃ kīrtayiṣyanti ye dvijāḥ
children.translated_text: Those twice-born men who will praise her as fire-colored, splendid, and gentle,

children.text: tāṃ tārayati durgāni naveva siṃdhuṃ duritāty agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: that fire carries them across difficulties and past evil, like a boat across the river.

children.text: durgeṣu viṣame ghore saṃgrāme ripusaṃkaṭe
children.translated_text: In difficult places, in rough and terrible situations, in battle, and in the peril of enemies,

children.text: agnicoranipāteṣu duṣṭagrahanivāraṇe duṣṭagrahanivāraṇy oṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in attacks by fire and thieves, and in warding off harmful planets, in warding off harmful planets: oṃ, homage.

children.text: durgeṣu viṣameṣu tvaṃ saṃgrāmeṣu vaneṣu ca
children.translated_text: In difficulties and dangerous places, in battles and in forests too, you are present.

children.text: mohayitvā prapadyante teṣāṃ me abhayaṃ kuru teṣāṃ me abhayaṃ kurv oṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they, bewildered, take refuge, grant fearlessness to them for me, grant fearlessness to them for me: oṃ, homage.

children.text: keśinīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pañcamīti ca nāma ca
children.translated_text: The long-haired one of all beings, and the name called Pañcamī,

children.text: sā māṃ samāṃ diśāṃ devī sarvataḥ parirakṣatu sarvataḥ parirakṣatu oṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that goddess protect me, equal in all directions, on every side; may she protect me on every side: oṃ, homage.

children.text: tām agnivarṇāṃ tapasā jvalantīṃ vairocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu juṣṭām
children.translated_text: That fire-colored one, blazing with ascetic heat, descended from <s>Virocana</s>, attached to the fruits of actions,

children.text: durgāṃ devīṃ śaraṇam ahaṃ pra padye sutarasi tarase namaḥ sutarasi tarase namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I take refuge in the goddess <s>Durgā</s>; you cross well, homage to the swift crossing; you cross well, homage to the swift crossing.

children.text: durgā durgeṣu sthāneṣu śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Durgā</s>, in difficult places and stations, may the goddesses be auspicious for our desired aid.

children.text: ya imaṃ durgāstavaṃ puṇyaṃ rātrau rātrau sadā paṭhet ||
children.translated_text: Whoever always recites this holy praise of <s>Durgā</s> night after night,

children.text: rātriḥ kuśikaḥ saubharo rātrir vā bhāradvājī rātristavaṃ gāyatram
children.translated_text: Night is of <s>Kuśika</s> Saubhara; or Night is Bhāradvājī; the praise of Night is in the Gāyatrī meter.

children.text: rātrisūktaṃ japen nityaṃ tatkāla upapadyate ||
children.translated_text: One should recite the Rātrisūkta daily; at that time it comes to pass.

children.text: Chapter 10
arvāñcam indram amuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajid aśvajid yaḥ
children.translated_text: From there we call <s>Indra</s> hither, the one who wins cattle, wins wealth, and wins horses.

children.text: imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave juṣasveha kurmo harivo vedinaṃ tvā ||
children.translated_text: Favor this sacrifice of ours in the invocation; here, O tawny-horsed one, we make you the one seated on the altar.

children.text: Chapter 11
namas te astu vidyute namas te stanayitnave
children.translated_text: Homage to you, O lightning; homage to you, O thunderer.

children.text: namas te astv aśmane yo mā dūṇāso asyasi ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you as the stone which you hurl, not harming me.

children.text: namas te pravato napād yattas tapaḥ samūhasi
children.translated_text: Homage to you, child of the cloud, since you gather up that heat.

children.text: mṛḍayā nas tanubhyo bhayaṃ naḥ paśubhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious to our bodies; let there be no fear for our cattle.

children.text: pravato napān nama evāstu tubhyam namas te hetaye tapuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage indeed to you, child of the cloud; we make homage to your weapon and to your burning heat.

children.text: vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yat samudre antar nihitāpi nāsi ||
children.translated_text: We know your highest name, which is hidden in secret within the ocean, though you are not enclosed.

children.text: yāṃ tvā devā ajaniṣṭa dhiṣva dhiyaṃ kṛṇvānā asanāya vājam
children.translated_text: You whom the gods generated, establishing insight and making strength for food,

children.text: sā no mṛḍa vidathe gṛṇānā tasyai te namo astu devi ||
children.translated_text: be gracious to us, praised in the assembly; to you, goddess, let there be homage.

children.text: Chapter 12
nejameṣa parā pata suputraḥ punar ā pata
children.translated_text: O <s>Nejameṣa</s>, fly away; as one having a good son, fly back again.

children.text: asyai me putrakāmāyai garbham ā dhehi yaḥ pumān ||
children.translated_text: Place in this woman of mine, who desires a son, a male embryo.

children.text: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahy uttānā garbham ā dadhe
children.translated_text: Just as this great earth, lying open, has received an embryo,

children.text: evaṃ taṃ garbham ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: so place that embryo in her, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ śraiṣṭhyena rūpeṇāsyāṃ nāryāṃ gavīnyām
children.translated_text: By the superior form of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, in this woman, in the womb-place,

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: place a male son, to be born in the tenth month.
